evals.prompt: 在 AI 上把当前 Ptyxis tag 编译成 x86_64 Flatpak，跑测试并告诉我产物和校验值。
evals.expected_output: Uses the x86 builder, verifies project version and tests, and reports the bundle path and SHA-256 without silently accepting unrelated build failures.
expectations: Uses scripts/build-x86-flatpak.sh rather than reconstructing the build ad hoc.
Rejects a mismatch between meson.build and the requested version.
Accepts the old-builder fallback only for the known appstream-compose failure after tests pass.
Reports the x86_64 bundle and SHA-256 output.

evals.prompt: 把 v50.3.1 的 ARM 版本放到 GitHub 上原生编译，通过后上传到已有 Release。
evals.expected_output: Dispatches the native ARM workflow, watches it to completion, and verifies both aarch64 release assets.
expectations: Uses scripts/dispatch-arm-release.sh and the ubuntu-24.04-arm workflow.
Waits for GitHub Actions to reach a terminal success state.
Verifies both the aarch64 Flatpak and checksum assets exist on the requested tag.

evals.prompt: 给 edge、spark、agx、nx1-4、nano1-3 安装最新版 Ptyxis；Flathub 很慢，走 AMD 的 10808 代理，并逐台确认 GUI 能启动。
evals.expected_output: Uses bounded fleet concurrency, architecture-specific assets, SSH reverse proxying, Flatpak installation and overrides, per-host version checks, and headless GUI initialization verification.
expectations: Uses scripts/install-flatpak-fleet.sh with bounded concurrency instead of ten unrestricted first-time downloads.
Detects each host architecture and chooses the matching Release asset.
Creates or reuses an SSH reverse proxy tunnel for slow Flathub downloads.
Applies the /app/lib64 Flatpak override and verifies the exact Ptyxis version per host.
Runs Xvfb GUI initialization checks and fails the fleet command when any host fails.
